programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Is the space economy the next gold rush? Elon Musk's SpaceX has sparked the public's imagination after its recent stock market debut, but what will all the money being thrown into the space industry actually achieve? The founder of leading investment firm Space Capital, Chad Anderson, explains how what happens in orbit is increasingly important to the economy down on Earth. Ben Thompson also hears from the head of the UN's Office for Outer Space Affairs, Aarti Holla-Maini, about how space law is keeping up with an industry that is moving at breakneck speed. Also on the programme, the billionaire founder of New Zealand-based Rocket Lab, Sir Peter Beck, shines a light on what the private sector can achieve in space and whether SpaceX are friends or rivals.

programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: The Zoological Society of London - the charity that runs London Zoo - is celebrating its 200th birthday this year. So, in an age when people are much more attuned to the welfare of animals, Roma Wells asks: what are zoos for? She sees for herself some of the pioneering innovation ZSL achieved in years gone by, some of the work it does today to rescue threatened species, and finds out what's next for animal attractions everywhere.

programme.title: The Climate Question
programme.desc: A global programme that reflects the variety of takes on climate change, how best to understand it and the world's attempts to avert it, temper it or adapt to it. It is not about questioning whether climate change is happening, it's about finding the best ways to respond to it. This is sharp-edged, analytical inquiry. Hard scrutiny, touched with a sense of adventure and discovery, and where we can find it, hope. It includes stories from across the world on why we find it so hard to save our own planet, and how we might change that.

programme.title: Talking Movies
programme.desc: Talking Movies reviews Hollywood's summer movie season and the success of the blockbusters The Odyssey and Spider-Man: Brand New Day. Tom Brook and his team look back at the big successes, costly misses and surprise packages of recent months, including the triumph of low-budget horror films Obsession and Backrooms. The evolution of the summer blockbuster is also explored through the classic movie Jaws. Emma Jones examines the release of De Gaulle - one of the most expensive French films of all time - while Tom celebrates the centenary of Route 66 by looking at the diner as a classic location for iconic American films.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: The Force of Nature team were in the field for three years to make the series. In order to film how animals were coping with today's wilder weather, the team had to put up with some spectacular weather - mega monsoons, raging wildfires, unprecedented droughts, marine heatwaves, hurricanes and even tornadoes. With the help of some of the world's scientists, the crew were able to film some extraordinary examples of animals fighting back, adapting and digging deep to overcome what is fast becoming the new normal. In this episode, we turn the camera on the extraordinary people who are dedicating their lives to helping the animals cope with today's extreme weather. From the elephant scientist negotiating with palm oil plantations to allow Bornean elephant safe passage, to the team of Indian wildlife protection officers who rescue and relocate precious snow leopards. All around the world, people are making small changes which make a world of a difference. These are their stories.

programme.title: Unbelievable Moments Caught On Camera
programme.desc: Unbelievable, shocking and uplifting viral videos filmed all over the world and narrated by award-winning actor Roger Allam. Go behind the lens to hear firsthand accounts of these once-in-a-lifetime experiences, starting in Arizona where two first responders happened to be in the right place at the right time to rescue a woman trapped in an inferno. In the mountains of East Asia, one intrepid traveller captures a once-in-a-lifetime experience on camera, while in Yorkshire, a commuter has a very close brush with death. Heading down under, we meet lifelong friends and fishermen who nearly became bait after their boat sank, and back in the UK, one toddler comes to her dad's rescue in the most remarkable way. Finally, we meet a family whose US road trip was crashed by a furry friend. All stories you wouldn't believe if they weren't caught on camera.

programme.desc: Kisah para pelari maraton nasional yang ingin berlari lagi setelah pembebasan Korea, dan upaya mereka untuk berkompetisi dalam maraton internasional pertama mereka.

programme.title: You Will Die In 6 Hours
programme.desc: Jun Woo memperingatkan Jeong Yun tentang pembunuhan yang akan menimpanya. Dengan rasa skeptis, ia mulai menyelidiki dan menemukan keterkaitan Jun Woo dengan serangkaian pembunuhan. Ia pun berpacu dengan waktu untuk mengetahui apakah Jun Woo melindunginya atau justru menipunya sebelum kematian yang telah diramalkan itu terjadi.

programme.title: Love Barista
programme.desc: Love Barista mengisahkan Kang Jun-woo, seorang aktor ternama Korea Selatan yang kariernya mulai meredup. Saat melakukan perjalanan ke Vietnam untuk syuting iklan, sebuah kesalahan membuatnya tertinggal tanpa paspor, uang, maupun manajernya. Dalam kondisi yang serba sulit, ia bertemu Thao, seorang perempuan lokal yang sedang berjuang mewujudkan impiannya menjadi barista profesional. Seiring waktu, keduanya saling membantu dan mulai memahami perbedaan budaya serta latar belakang masing-masing. Hubungan yang awalnya tidak disengaja berkembang menjadi kisah cinta yang manis, sembari mengajarkan arti keberanian, harapan, dan kesempatan kedua dalam hidup.

programme.title: ActionHero
programme.desc: Seorang mahasiswa yang bermimpi menjadi aktor laga menemukan sebuah kecurangan pendaftaran. Ia memutuskan untuk membuat sebuah film aksi dirinya melawan profesor yang korup.

programme.title: Pretty Crazy (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang calon koki kue hidup tanpa menyadari bahwa setiap malam ia berubah menjadi iblis betina yang liar. Keluarganya menyewa tetangga mereka untuk mengawasi wujud malamnya, sementara si tetangga jatuh cinta pada wujud siangnya dan berusaha mematahkan kutukannya.

programme.title: The Attorney (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Song Woo-seok adalah seorang pengacara yang tidak memiliki klien. Ketika anak laki-laki temannya dituduh salah atas sebuah kejahatan dan disiksa, ia mengambil kasus tersebut, dan jalannya hidupnya berubah selamanya.

programme.title: Dragon Inn: The City Of Sadness
programme.desc: Dragon Inn: The City of Sadness mengisahkan sebuah organisasi vigilante yang beroperasi secara rahasia di balik sebuah restoran bernama Dragon Inn. Kelompok ini menjalankan misinya sendiri untuk menghukum para pelaku kejahatan yang tidak tersentuh hukum. Setiap anggota memiliki masa lalu kelam dan alasan pribadi yang mendorong mereka bergabung. Situasi berubah ketika putra seorang pengusaha terkenal ditemukan tewas dan salah satu anggota Dragon Inn diduga terlibat dalam kasus tersebut. Di tengah penyelidikan, berbagai rahasia, pengkhianatan, dan konflik berdarah mulai terungkap. Para anggota harus berjuang menghadapi musuh dari luar sekaligus mempertahankan kepercayaan satu sama lain dalam dunia yang dipenuhi korupsi dan balas dendam.

programme.title: The King's Letters
programme.desc: Raja Sejong ingin menciptakan alfabet asli untuk rakyatnya. Dengan bantuan beberapa orang lain, mereka berjuang untuk menciptakan alfabet Korea yang disebut Hangul.

programme.title: The Childe
programme.desc: Marco, seorang petinju yang lahir dari ayah Korea dan ibu Filipina. Akibat kesulitan keuangan dan ibu yang sakit-sakitan, Marco memutuskan pergi ke Korea Selatan untuk mencari keberadaan sang ayah yang sejak kecil meninggalkannya. Setibanya di Korea Selatan, Marco mendadak menjadi buronan seorang pria misterius dan sekelompok orang jahat yang tak pernah berhenti mengejarnya.
